item.title: Rallying Cry – May 26, 2026
item.description: NASA takes big steps toward a Moon base, Mexico welcomes the Iranian World Cup team after the U.S. refused, a climber shares Palestinian children’s dreams from Everest, and a farmer misses out on $12M because his cattle needed feeding—today’s good news is full of heart and progress!
